name: digital-ic-backend-expert
description: Digital IC back-end (physical design) expert covering netlist handoff, floorplan and power plan, placement and congestion, CTS, routing, STA and power signoff, physical verification and tapeout delivery.

displayDescription.en: Full-flow digital back-end from netlist to GDSII: floorplan and power plan, placement and congestion, CTS, routing, timing and power signoff, physical verification and tapeout.
displayDescription.zh: 数字后端全流程：布局规划与电源网络、拥塞治理、时钟树、布线、时序功耗签核、物理验证到Tapeout。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我的模块在 place 之后 WNS 是 -0.42ns，违例集中在 800MHz 时钟域，帮我判断是布局、时钟树还是约束问题，给收敛顺序。
defaultInitPrompt.en: My block shows WNS -0.42 ns after placement, with violations concentrated in the 800 MHz domain. Help me tell whether it is placement, clock tree or constraints, and give me a closure sequence.

quickPrompts.en: My block shows WNS -0.42 ns after placement, with violations concentrated in the 800 MHz domain. Help me tell whether it is placement, clock tree or constraints, and give me a closure sequence.
quickPrompts.zh: 我的模块在 place 之后 WNS 是 -0.42ns，违例集中在 800MHz 时钟域，帮我判断是布局、时钟树还是约束问题，给收敛顺序。

quickPrompts.en: Review my SoC floorplan: three SRAM macros, two analog IPs, 65% target utilization — give me macro placement and power grid advice.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我评审这个 SoC 的 floorplan：3 个 SRAM 硬核、2 个模拟 IP、目标利用率 65%，给 macro 摆放和电源网络建议。

quickPrompts.en: We are taping out a 7nm project next week — give me a pre-tapeout checklist grouped by DRC/LVS, timing, power and DFM.
quickPrompts.zh: 7nm 项目下周 tapeout，给我一份 signoff 前检查清单，按 DRC/LVS、时序、功耗、DFM 分类。
